about: The collecta of the formulary “Seven Sorrows of the Blessed Virgin Mary” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: O God, in Whose Passion the sword, according to the prophecy of blessed Simeon, pierced through the soul of Mary, the glorious Virgin and Mother, mercifully grant that we, who reverently commemorate her piercing through and her suffering, may, by the interceding glorious merits of all the saints faithfully standing by the Cross, obtain the abundant fruit of Your passion. Who livest and reignest with God the Father in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end. Amen.
